item.title: Lakers News: Marcus Smart Fined For Making Obscene Gesture At Official
item.description: Los Angeles Lakers guard Marcus Smart has been fined $35,000 for making an obscene gesture towards a game official, it was announced by James Jones, Executive Vice President, Head of Basketball Operations with the NBA. The incident occurred at halftime of the Lakers’ 143-135 win over the Utah Jazz at Delta Center on Thursday night. […]
